newsitem.title: USA: Burlington, Vt., mayor wants 5 pct rise in budget.
newsitem.headline: Burlington, Vt., mayor wants 5 pct rise in budget.

text.p: Burlington, Vt., Mayor Peter Clavell, who has proposed a new $28 million budget that would raise spending by five percent, wants to cut costs by ending the $42,000 a year city clerk position.
City Clerk Kit Andrews has already announced plans to step down this year. The mayor wants to parcel out her duties to other city employees.
Clavell also wants to consolidate management and maintenance duties among city departments in the 1998 fiscal budget.
